one: The network fabric of AI clusters: fat trees, congestion control, and scheduling, aiming for ultra-low latency and near-100% goodput.
pos: CS 349F focuses on the interconnect networks of large GPU/CPU clusters and on time-sensitive systems such as financial trading and multiplayer games. It covers data-center fabric architectures, transport protocols, congestion control, load balancing, and scheduling, with industry experts discussing real cluster design and operations.
prereq: CS 144/CS 140 or distributed-systems basics; EE 178 helps.
assess: 2 units, S/NC; discussion plus a project/case study. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Networking, clusters, and data centers; anyone working on AI infrastructure.
tips: Read it with CS 349D/E to get the full single-machine, cluster, and network picture.
note: Offered in Autumn 2026–27; the official site is restricted, so only the ExploreCourses link is provided.
